_comment: Floors and expectations for the deployment gate; see gate/README.md. The scan matrix is derived from codeql-config.yml's packs: keys via languageMap, so a new pack language fails the gate until it gains a block here. languageMap lists only languages that build with build-mode: none.

actions._comment: Dormant until codeql-config.yml gains an actions: packs key (PR #19). Floor is 16, NOT 17: the built-in suite resolves 17 but this config's query-filters exclude actions/missing-workflow-permissions. Do not 'fix' it back to 17. When the custom pack pins, raise to 19 (16 + 3 custom) and list those 3 ids in expectedRuleIds.
